issues: Strike ability is encoded incorrectly as grantLeaderDamageShield; it should prevent this follower from taking damage for the rest of the turn, e.g. by granting damage immunity to self until end of turn.

Fanfare is encoded with an incorrect condition namedFollowerOnFieldByName 'Regal Wildcat'; the source condition is 'If your leader is [swordcraft]', so the fanfare should be gated by a leader-class condition rather than checking for this follower on the field.
The card should not have a second unconditional duplicate fanfare ability; there is only one fanfare effect.

The 'give to each other follower on your field instead' branch is not conditional on your leader being Swordcraft and is represented as a free choice; it should happen only if your leader is Swordcraft.
The all-followers branch uses buffFieldTrait without restricting to all other followers correctly; it should buff each other follower on your field and grant them Storm, excluding this card.

Play cost reduction is encoded incorrectly with cemeteryFilterCount over all cemetery cards; it should count the number of cards with different base costs in your cemetery. Implement a dynamic amount for distinct base costs in cemetery, then use that as playCostReduction amount.
Ward is encoded incorrectly as a fanfare passiveKeywords ability; Ward is a printed keyword and should be in keywords, not as a fanfare ability.

On Evolve buff amount is encoded from the selected follower's attack using targetAttack; it should give the summoned Assembly Droid +X/+X where X equals the selected follower's cost. Implement a dynamic amount based on selected target cost, then use that for buffDynamic on the last summoned token.

Fanfare damage amount is encoded incorrectly as namedIdentityFieldCount 'faceup evolved followers'; it should equal the number of faceup evolved followers in your evolve deck. Implement a dynamic amount for counting faceup evolved followers in evolve deck, then use it as the damage amount.

Turning a faceup evolved follower in your evolve deck facedown is encoded with turnEvolveDeck using unsupported/incorrect orientation and filter fields; it should specifically select a faceup evolved follower in your evolve deck and turn it facedown. Implement support for selecting a faceup evolved card in evolve deck and turning it facedown.

Fanfare condition is encoded incorrectly as ownCemeteryMin 3; it should check whether there are at least 3 faceup evolved followers in your evolve deck. Implement a condition for minimum faceup evolved followers in evolve deck, then use it to gate the auto-evolve effect.
Start of end phase ability is encoded incorrectly as a single buff with atk+2/def+2 to self and malformed leader targeting; it should give this follower +0/+2 and separately give your leader +0/+2.
